messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- Boreal reported at standup on 2026-02-04 that the scheduler's error rate crept up to 2 percent following the dependency bump. [valid 2026-02-04 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-02-04]
- The scheduler is not a Boreal service; Boreal flagged the scheduler at standup on 2026-02-04. [valid 2026-02-04 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-02-04]
- The job scheduler depends on the flags service for per-job kill switches; if the flags service is down, the job scheduler is down. [valid 2025-03-28 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-03-28]
- Team Atlas saw on 2026-04-16 that billing-api's error rate crept up to 2 percent following the dependency bump. [valid 2026-04-16 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-04-16]
- After the runtime upgrade, the job scheduler's cold start time tripled. [valid 2025-04-24 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-04-24]
- Team Ember reported at standup on 2025-11-17 that the authentication gateway's error rate crept up to 2 percent following the dependency bump. [valid 2025-11-17 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-11-17]
- The job scheduler's single fixed node turned every restart into a missed run. [valid 2025-06-16 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-06-16]
- The authentication gateway is not Team Ember's service. [valid 2025-11-17 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-11-17]
- Boreal has a weekly dependency update day as of 2026-05-04. [decision; valid 2026-05-04 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-05-04]
- Team Atlas's planning meeting is every Tuesday. [valid 2026-04-16 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-04-16-2]
- The flags service is Team Atlas's service as of 2026-04-21, after moving from Team Dune. [decision; valid 2026-04-21 to now; recorded by handover/2026-04-21-feature-flags]
    earlier: The flags service is Team Dune's service as of 2026-01-29, after moving from Cinder. [decision; valid 2026-01-29 to 2026-04-21; recorded by handover/2026-01-29-feature-flags]
    earlier: The flags service is not Team Dune's service, so Team Dune flagged the issue instead of fixing it. [valid 2025-09-18 to 2026-01-29; recorded by standup/dune/2025-09-18]
- Team Dune owns the job scheduler as of 2025-04-04. [valid 2025-04-04 to now; recorded by handover/2025-04-04-scheduler]
    earlier: Ember owns the job scheduler. [valid 2025-01-20 to 2025-04-04; recorded by standup/ember/2025-01-20]
- The notifier is not Cinder's service, so Cinder flagged the issue instead of fixing it. [valid 2025-09-26 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-09-26]
- The scheduler ran the nightly jobs twice on 2026-05-16 during INC-2026-009. [valid 2026-05-22 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-009]
- The job scheduler remains a Team Dune service as of 2026-01-12. [valid 2026-01-12 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-01-12]
- Ledger is not Team Dune's service, so Team Dune flagged the latency issue instead of fixing it. [valid 2025-12-08 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-12-08]
- billing-api is not Team Atlas's service, so Team Atlas flagged the error rate instead of fixing it. [valid 2026-04-16 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-04-16]
- Ledger is not Team Atlas's service, so Team Atlas flagged the disk usage jump instead of fixing it. [valid 2026-04-16 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-04-16-2]
- The job scheduler will use leader election instead of a single fixed node. [decision; valid 2025-06-16 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-06-16]
- Oskar wrote up the handover doc for Farah for the job scheduler handover on 2025-04-04. [valid 2025-04-04 to now; recorded by handover/2025-04-04-scheduler]
